lore.projectseele.archive.0.title: Dead Sea Scrolls
lore.projectseele.archive.1.title: Opening Fragment
lore.projectseele.archive.1.text:
On this world's first night, two seeds descended.

The White Moon bore Adam. The Black Moon bore Lilith. Meant for separate lands, they awoke on the same earth.

Later ages called it a catastrophe. The scrolls record a deviation.
lore.projectseele.archive.2.title: Two Fruits
lore.projectseele.archive.2.text:
The Fruit of Life grants endurance. The Fruit of Knowledge grants awareness of the self.

One line inherited an undying form. The other multiplied in fragile flesh.

Should both fruits dwell in one body, the bounds of human language will no longer suffice to name it.
lore.projectseele.archive.3.title: Instruments of Restraint
lore.projectseele.archive.3.text:
The giants were fashioned after the Seeds of Life. Their armor serves also as their shackles.

The plug may be inserted and the hatch sealed. Yet the answer from deep within the body is no promise of obedience.

If the one who seeks entry is refused, every order echoes into silence.
lore.projectseele.archive.4.title: The Wall of the Heart
lore.projectseele.archive.4.text:
This wall is unseen. It sets you apart from others and allows you to remain yourself.

When two walls meet, they may repel or cancel each other.

When the last wall falls, no one will be alone. Who can say what will remain of the self?
lore.projectseele.archive.5.title: The Lance and the Seed
lore.projectseele.archive.5.text:
The lance was left beside the seed as a pledge of ending and silence.

Once it leaves its watch, the old balance can no longer be trusted.

Let its bearer remember that what can silence a giant can also open the way for a rite.
lore.projectseele.archive.6.title: The Promised Place
lore.projectseele.archive.6.text:
At the alarm, the city sinks beneath the surface. Amid a sea of trees the pyramid guards a gate to greater depths.

Beyond it lies the silence of the white giant.

The returning children will follow this path to the sealed place.
lore.projectseele.archive.7.title: The Unwritten Page
lore.projectseele.archive.7.text:
The order of the children's coming is written. The choices of those who meet them remain blank.

Whom shall they send into battle? What shall they keep for those who return?

Those who still live must write these names.
lore.projectseele.archive.8.title: The Seal
lore.projectseele.archive.8.text:
The volume ends here.

The remaining fragments are sealed by agreement.
